name: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech_recognition/new/decoders/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.generate_decoder_output: generate speech recognition output by running models on encoder input and decoding emissions
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_emissions_from_model: get emissions from a fairseq model by calling get_logits or get_normalized_probs on encoder output
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.get_tokens_from_indices: get tokens from a sequence of indices by deduplicating consecutive values and filtering blanks
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_basedecoder_class: review the BaseDecoder class and its methods for CTC-based speech recognition decoding
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.summarize_basedecoder_init: summarize the BaseDecoder init method that sets up blank and silence tokens from the target dictionary

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_viterbi_decoder: create a ViterbiDecoder instance by calling Decoder with a viterbi config and target dictionary
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_kenlm_decoder: create a KenLMDecoder instance by calling Decoder with a kenlm config and target dictionary
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.create_fairseqlm_decoder: create a FairseqLMDecoder instance by calling Decoder with a fairseqlm config and target dictionary
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_Decoder_factory: review the Decoder factory function that returns a BaseDecoder based on config type
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.summarize_Decoder: summarize the Decoder factory function that supports viterbi, kenlm, and fairseqlm decoder types

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_KenLMDecoder: build a KenLMDecoder with a lexicon and KenLM for CTC beam search decoding
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.decode_KenLMDecoder: decode audio emissions using KenLMDecoder to get n-best hypotheses with tokens and words
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_FairseqLM: build a FairseqLM wrapper around a FairseqModel for language model scoring during decoding
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.score_FairseqLM: score a token given the current LM state and return the new state and log probability
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.build_FairseqLMDecoder: build a FairseqLMDecoder that uses a Fairseq model as the language model for speech decoding

facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.decode_ctc_emissions: decode CTC emission probabilities into token sequences using Viterbi greedy decoding
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.compute_log_softmax_score: compute the sum of max log-softmax scores from emission probabilities for each timestep
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.extract_unique_consecutive_tokens: extract unique consecutive token predictions from emission argmax results
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.filter_blank_tokens: filter out CTC blank tokens from the predicted token sequence
facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/speech.review_ViterbiDecoder_decode: review the ViterbiDecoder decode method and its CTC greedy decoding logic
